description.zh: 语言环境, 默认为中文 zh | en。
description.en: The language. Valid values: zh and en. Default value: zh.

description.zh: Feature的名称 app-agent-pilot | metric-agent | ebpf-agent | service-check。
description.en: The feature name. Valid values: app-agent-pilot, metric-agent, ebpf-agent, and service-check.

description.zh: 开关服务发现用, PodAnnotation | PodMonitor | ServiceMonitor, PodAnnotation开关是run和mini, pm和sm则传 true和false, 例如 {"PodAnnotation":"run"}。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable service discovery. For PodAnnotation, set the value to run or mini. For PodMonitor and ServiceMonitor, set the value to true or false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms upgrade-environment-feature --environment-id env-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --feature-name metric-agent --feature-version 1.1.17 --values PodAnnotation_:_run --aliyun-lang zh --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
